sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 640x512, 17 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD <35 mK; optical: 1/1.8in 4MP CMOS
features: dual-PTZ bi-spectrum positioning system with independently rotatable 640x512 thermal and 4MP visible channels
uncooled VOx thermal detector (640x512, 17 um), NETD <35 mK
thermal lens 25 / 50 mm; visible 45x optical zoom (5.5-248 mm)
IR illumination 250 m (optional 600 m); sound and white-light alarm to 200 m
thermal head pan 0 to +190 / tilt -5 to +180; visible head pan 0-360 / tilt -30 to +90; 300 presets
release_notes: Ultra-series dual-PTZ positioning system with independently steerable 640x512 thermal and 4MP 45x visible channels, 250 m IR and sound/white-light deterrence for long-range perimeter defence.

frigate.notes: Dahua RTSP convention; channel 1 = visible/fusion, channel 2 = thermal. Not verified against a live unit.

home_assistant.notes: Dahua ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and visible exposed as separate channels (visible = channel 1, thermal = channel 2). PTZ via ONVIF.
